method: Read glTF accessor data; reconstruct global bind transforms from inverse bind matrices; evaluate LINEAR translation and shortest-path quaternion SLERP at source key times; CPU linear-blend skinning. Spatial region proxies are not semantic armor segmentation. No Unreal process or GPU/rendered deformation review.

axes.gltf: Right-handed: +Y up; +Z front from headfront and toe offsets; +X anatomical left.
axes.unreal_gltf_conversion: UE GLTFCore ConversionUtilities.h ConvertVec3: (x,y,z)->(x,z,y); positions multiplied by 100 for cm. Front becomes +Y; mesh yaw -90 degrees aligns to actor +X. Verify importer has not applied an additional basis.

Running.sampler_end_note: Hips translation alone extends to the total duration; all 63 remaining channels end at 0.6333330273628235 s. Shorter channels are held at their final key until the total end.

Walking.sampler_end_note: Hips translation alone extends to the total duration; all 63 remaining channels end at 1.0333329439163208 s. Shorter channels are held at their final key until the total end.

Right.centroid_method: Mean of spatial hand-proxy vertices weighted by this named Hand bone; proxy includes glove/hand surface, not a verified grip centre.
Right.neutral_carry_proposal: Exact transform for the stated candidate only: grip pivot at hand-weighted region centroid, blade points character forward (+Z glTF/+Y imported UE), cutting edge downward (-Y glTF/-Z UE). This is not an authored socket or a validated grip.

Left.centroid_method: Mean of spatial hand-proxy vertices weighted by this named Hand bone; proxy includes glove/hand surface, not a verified grip centre.
Left.neutral_carry_proposal: Exact transform for the stated candidate only: grip pivot at hand-weighted region centroid, blade points character forward (+Z glTF/+Y imported UE), cutting edge downward (-Y glTF/-Z UE). This is not an authored socket or a validated grip.

limitations: No idle, guard, attack, parry, dodge, stagger, execution, death or weapon animation clips are supplied.
No individual finger chains, armor plate bones, cloth simulation or sword sockets are supplied.
Weight and edge-strain statistics cannot prove acceptable armor deformation or absence of intersections.
Only locomotion key samples were evaluated; combat retargeting can expose larger deformation errors.
Attachment matrices are mathematical candidates tied to explicit axes/pivot choices; hand pose and grip contact require visual validation.

verification.matrix_convention: Column vectors; 4x4 matrix rows serialize translation in the last column. UE FMatrix uses row-vector layout; transpose matrix if constructing FMatrix directly. FQuat fields below use x,y,z,w.
verification.region_edge_metric: Unique triangle edges with both endpoints inside each bind-space proxy, initial length >0.002 m. Absolute fractional length change = abs(animated_length / bind_length - 1). P95 pools edges and source-key samples equally, not duration-weighted. No collision/intersection analysis.

region_selectors_gltf_metres.foot_surface_probes: Left X > 0 / Right X < 0; bind Y < 0.16. Track those vertices through skinning.

mapping_to_kwang_semantics.neck_note: One Meshy Neck versus Kwang neck_01 and neck_02: collapse/distribute the source neck chain explicitly; do not discard one transform without checking head orientation.
mapping_to_kwang_semantics.non_equivalent: Kwang root, weapon_l/r, individual finger chains, twist, armor, cloth and IK bones have no equivalent in this 32-joint skin. Preserve weighted Bone_019/020/024/025 rather than treating them as empty end markers. Pair names identify anatomy only; bind bases/lengths still require retarget calibration.

virtual_wrist_fix.method: Read-only virtual correction. Global auxiliary parent = animated Hand global * inverse(Hand bind global) * auxiliary bind global. Auxiliary child global = corrected parent global * inverse(auxiliary bind global) * child bind global. Original GLB is not changed. Evaluate all source key times with unchanged main hand/forearm/body tracks.

saya_attachment.qualification: Exact transform for the requested mouth position, backward/down tip axis, and projected-up cutting edge. No mesh intersection, belt attachment or visual fit verified.
